title: ENT doctor visit
what: An ENT doctor examines your ears, nose, and throat. Many problems can be seen right away and treated on the spot.
why: For ear or throat pain, a blocked nose, a runny nose that lasts longer than usual, hearing loss, snoring, or nosebleeds.
tell_doctor: What bothers you and for how long
What medicines and drops you have tried
Past ear, nose, or throat surgery

prepare.title: Drops
prepare.text: If you use nose or ear drops, tell your doctor. Do not stop treatment on your own.

prepare.title: Questions
prepare.text: Write down your symptoms and questions beforehand.

steps: The doctor asks about your symptoms
Your throat is checked with a tongue depressor
Your nose is checked with a small speculum or a thin camera
Your ears are checked with a funnel or microscope
The doctor explains what was found and gives treatment
feel: The tongue depressor may make you gag
Nose and ear checks usually do not hurt
after: If tests or scans were ordered, have them done and come back
red_flags: Trouble breathing or swallowing, or drooling: call emergency services
Severe ear pain with swelling behind the ear and a fever: see a doctor urgently

faq.q: Can I clean my ears myself?
faq.a: Do not push cotton swabs deep inside. If there is a wax plug, the doctor will remove it.

faq.q: Do I need a referral to an ENT?
faq.a: It depends on the clinic and your insurance. Ask when booking.

reminders.text: ENT visit in 2 hours. Bring past reports and your medicine list.
